`final class GlSnapshotCapture`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.opengl.snapshot` · **Module:** `base-opengl` · **Source:** [GlSnapshotCapture.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/opengl/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/opengl/snapshot/GlSnapshotCapture.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 2</span> <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

Reads the back buffer of an OpenGL context into a snapshot image.

## Description

It ships in the dev and demo jars of the backends, not in the prod jar of base-opengl.
